raw.title: EverCommerce - Data Product Manager
raw.excerpt: At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 725,000+ customers.
raw.description:
At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 725,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://careers.evercommerce.com/us/en

EverCommerce is seeking a Data Product Manager to lead the strategy and delivery of our Enterprise Reporting function and data/reporting for the EverPro line of business– the high-level, executive-facing reporting layer that powers strategic decision-making across the company. This role is central to how we communicate key business performance indicators to senior leadership, including our CEO, CFO, Board of Directors, and business unit heads.

As the Data Product Manager, you will be responsible for defining the roadmap for enterprise reporting, ensuring consistent and timely delivery of accurate data, and acting as the subject matter expert on EverCommerce’s core KPIs. You’ll work cross-functionally with FP&A, business operations, data engineering, and executive stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, clarify business needs, and ensure alignment across reporting processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Enterprise Reporting Roadmap: Define and manage the strategic direction of high-level reporting products used across the company, with a focus on usability, accuracy, and executive alignment.
  • Lead KPI Stewardship: Act as the SME on all enterprise KPIs – ensuring consistency, clarity, and documentation of definitions and methodologies.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Collaborate with analytics, FP&A, and data engineering teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of quarterly and monthly reporting packages (e.g., for Earnings Calls and Board meetings).
  • Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for senior leaders regarding enterprise reporting needs, data interpretation, and roadmap prioritization.
  • Reporting QA & Governance: Own the QA process and change management protocols for all executive reporting assets to ensure a high standard of data integrity.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps in data availability, reporting processes, and visualization tools, and work to drive improvements that scale across EverCommerce’s portfolio of businesses.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, data analytics, or business intelligence, preferably in a multi-brand or enterprise environment
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional data initiatives with executive visibility
  • Deep understanding of business KPIs, financial metrics, and operational reporting
  • Strong project management skills, with experience developing roadmaps and managing stakeholder expectations
  • Excellent communication skills – able to translate complex data topics into clear business language for senior audiences
  • Familiarity with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, dbt), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) is a plus
  • Experience in the Payments domain - familiarity with tools, compliance requirements, standards, etc. is a big plus

Where: This is a fully remote, US based position with minimal to no travel required. You may be asked to travel up to 4 times per year for quarterly planning. The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program ​

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A little more about your role:

The Offshore Substation Structural Lead will play a pivotal role in engineering and technical matters associated with offshore substations. This is a key growth area for WSP and offers an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated and resourceful engineer to help drive and realise the company’s offshore wind strategy. The role will work across engineering and design, Owner’s Engineering and smaller scopes, requiring strong leadership and the ability to manage complex projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical authority for offshore substation structural engineering including topsides and jacket / monopile support structures.
  • Take on offshore substation package manager roles on design projects and be responsible for co-ordinating and managing a multi-discipline team of engineers including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, cables, technical safety etc.
  • Responsible for the topside layout design process to optimise equipment and room layouts with respect to constructability, operability, technical safety and structural weight.
  • Support on Owner’s Engineer contracts and be competent to undertake design reviews; authoring of key project documentation such as Basis of Design, Technical Specifications and Employer’s Requirements; support of main asset procurement processes; and management of risk and programme.
  • Support the growth of the offshore substation team in a global environment.
  • Develop and implement new processes and procedures to streamline efficient delivery execution of offshore substation projects.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the offshore wind sector, contributing to the growth of the engineering function. Represent the company in technical discussions with stakeholders including clients, regulatory bodies and industry partners.
  • Lead and contribute to the development of bids and proposals with a particular focus on technical content.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant technical regulations, standards and best practices.
  • Manage technical budgets, schedules and resources effectively.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, project management, asset management, advisory and environmental teams.
  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in offshore wind technology and incorporate innovative solutions into projects.

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate:

  • MEng in structural or civil engineering.
  • Chartered Engineer or demonstratable progress in working towards.
  • Significant experience in offshore substation topside and jacket / monopile support structures.
  • Track record in delivery of offshore substation projects across all phases from concept, through to FEED, detailed design, fabrication and installation.
  • Experience in supporting certification of offshore substations.
  • Experience in preparation of offshore substation CAPEX estimates.
  • Experience in developing key offshore substation technical documentation in support of main asset procurement such as Employer’s Requirements and Scope of Works.
  • Excellent knowledge of the offshore wind industry and project development.
  • Excellent knowledge of offshore substation industry standards.
  • Excellent knowledge of Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 including a demonstratable understanding of health, safety and environmental best practice.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills coupled with strong leadership and management experience.
  • Excellent organisation skills with the ability to manage own workload, meet timescales and coordinate both internal and external stakeholders.
  • An established network in the offshore wind industry.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us:
Founded in 1995, ADLINK is one of the world’s leading-edge computing companies and a technology-leading platform provider in the embedded computing industry. Headquartered in Taiwan, ADLINK has operations in the United States, UK, Singapore, China, Japan, Korea and Germany. With more than 1,800 dedicated employees around the world, we are proud to provide ADLINK products to over 40 countries across five continents, with worldwide distribution networks. ADLINK is also proud to be associated with many major technology leaders and Fortune 500 companies.

Salary Range: $150,000 - $180,000
The Technical Sales Engineer position is remote.

How will you make an impact:
Work closely with the ADLINK sales team on new opportunities and drive solutions to meet customers’ needs which may include carrier designs, semi-custom based ADLINK standard products, and full custom system level solutions. Provide architectural ideas and solutions to meet customers’ requirements. Learn the customers pain points. Lead engineering teams responsible for the design of these products from concept through to production launch. This role also requires strong technical program management skills. The types of designs will vary based on customer, market and company needs but in general can include leading edge next generation x86 processor, ARM based tablets, COM Express, SMARC, and NVIDIA Jetson, carriers, products, or systems.

What will you do:
  • Manage new opportunities that require Technical Sales Engineer support through the use of SalesForce.

raw.description:
At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 725,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://careers.evercommerce.com/us/en

EverCommerce is seeking a Data Product Manager to lead the strategy and delivery of our Enterprise Reporting function and data/reporting for the EverPro line of business– the high-level, executive-facing reporting layer that powers strategic decision-making across the company. This role is central to how we communicate key business performance indicators to senior leadership, including our CEO, CFO, Board of Directors, and business unit heads.

As the Data Product Manager, you will be responsible for defining the roadmap for enterprise reporting, ensuring consistent and timely delivery of accurate data, and acting as the subject matter expert on EverCommerce’s core KPIs. You’ll work cross-functionally with FP&A, business operations, data engineering, and executive stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, clarify business needs, and ensure alignment across reporting processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Enterprise Reporting Roadmap: Define and manage the strategic direction of high-level reporting products used across the company, with a focus on usability, accuracy, and executive alignment.
  • Lead KPI Stewardship: Act as the SME on all enterprise KPIs – ensuring consistency, clarity, and documentation of definitions and methodologies.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Collaborate with analytics, FP&A, and data engineering teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of quarterly and monthly reporting packages (e.g., for Earnings Calls and Board meetings).
  • Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for senior leaders regarding enterprise reporting needs, data interpretation, and roadmap prioritization.
  • Reporting QA & Governance: Own the QA process and change management protocols for all executive reporting assets to ensure a high standard of data integrity.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps in data availability, reporting processes, and visualization tools, and work to drive improvements that scale across EverCommerce’s portfolio of businesses.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, data analytics, or business intelligence, preferably in a multi-brand or enterprise environment
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional data initiatives with executive visibility
  • Deep understanding of business KPIs, financial metrics, and operational reporting
  • Strong project management skills, with experience developing roadmaps and managing stakeholder expectations
  • Excellent communication skills – able to translate complex data topics into clear business language for senior audiences
  • Familiarity with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, dbt), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) is a plus
  • Experience in the Payments domain - familiarity with tools, compliance requirements, standards, etc. is a big plus

Where: This is a fully remote, US based position with minimal to no travel required. You may be asked to travel up to 4 times per year for quarterly planning. The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program ​

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

What You Will Do:
The MHS Data Analyst supports enterprise-wide Revenue Cycle Modernization and Innovation (RCMI) initiatives across the Military Health System (MHS). This role is responsible for executing analytical efforts across a diverse portfolio of internal and external projects ranging from rapid-turnaround analyses to complex, long-term efforts supporting Defense Health Agency (DHA) strategic priorities. The analyst serves as a connector across MHS directorates, DHA leadership, and external partners to advance data-driven decision-making and modernize revenue cycle operations. Success in this role requires deep familiarity with the MHS data ecosystem, including MHS GENESIS, Health Data Intelligence (HDI), Discern Analytics, Bulk Data Extract (BDE), M2, FMIS, SQLFarm, and other MHS Information Platform (MIP) tools. The analyst will develop actionable insights, ensure audit-readiness, and support enterprise performance management across Revenue Cycle initiatives. This position proactively identifies operational challenges, performs root-cause analyses, and supports the design of innovative, data-informed solutions to strengthen revenue cycle performance across the MHS while independently managing project-level tasks and deliverables.

The ideal candidate combines advanced technical skills (Vertica SQL, analytics, database engineering) with deep domain expertise in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM). This analyst will play a critical role in supporting DHA leadership by developing reporting capabilities across MHS Data Systems and collaborating across MHS directorates and stakeholders.

Responsibilities of this role are as follows, to include but not limited to:

  • Manage project-level tasks and workflows across internal and external revenue cycle data initiatives.

  • Conduct analysis of large, complex data sets across various tools and platforms (HDI, Discern Visual Developer, SQL, Python, etc.).

  • Serve as a key point-of-contact for leadership, internal stakeholders, and external partners on data-related project efforts.

  • Develop dashboards and reports (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) and present findings to senior leadership, DHA directorates, and diverse stakeholders.

  • Translate analytical outputs into clear narratives and visualizations to inform decision-making and support leadership briefings.

UI / Product Designer (Visual & Design Systems Focus)

About the Role
We’re looking for a designer who can take structured UX ideas and wireframes and turn them into polished, production-ready designs. You’ll focus on creating clean, modern interfaces that are not only beautiful — but also built in a way that developers can use directly.

This is not a blank-page UX role — you’ll be working from defined flows and wireframes, bringing them to life visually and ensuring consistency across the product.

What You’ll Do

  • Turn wireframes into high-fidelity designs in Figma
  • Create clean, modern, and consistent UI across all screens
  • Build and maintain a scalable design system (components, styles, tokens)
  • Structure files using proper auto-layout, components, and naming conventions
  • Prepare designs for smooth developer handoff (clear, organized, and export-ready)
  • Ensure consistency in spacing, typography, and interaction patterns
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to ensure designs are practical and implementable

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong Figma skills (auto-layout, components, variants, styles)
  • Strong visual design fundamentals (spacing, hierarchy, typography, color)
  • Ability to take wireframes and elevate them into polished UI
  • Experience building or working within a design system
  • Ability to structure design files cleanly for developer handoff
    • Organized layers and naming
    • Reusable components
    • Logical spacing and constraints
    • Assets that can be exported without cleanup
  • Strong attention to detail and consistency

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing SaaS or mobile apps
  • Understanding of frontend constraints (React, iOS, etc.)
  • Experience working closely with developers
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows

How We Work

  • Clear UX direction and wireframes provided
  • You own the visual execution and system consistency
  • High bar for clean, usable, and dev-ready design
  • Fast-paced, product-focused environment

Requirements

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing web or mobile applications (not just marketing/graphics)
  • Strong proficiency in Figma (auto-layout, components, variants, styles)
  • Ability to turn wireframes into clean, high-fidelity UI
  • Strong understanding of visual design fundamentals (spacing, typography, hierarchy, color)
  • Experience building or working within a design system
    • Reusable components
    • Consistent spacing and layout rules
    • Scalable styles and tokens
  • Ability to create developer-ready design files
    • Clean, well-organized layers and naming conventions
    • Proper use of auto-layout and constraints
    • Components structured for reuse
    • Assets/icons exported cleanly without redesign
    • Clear and practical handoff to developers
  • Strong attention to detail and consistency across screens
  • Ability to follow direction while elevating the visual quality

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience designing SaaS or complex product interfaces
  • Basic understanding of frontend development (React, iOS, etc.)
  • Experience working closely with engineers
  • Familiarity with modern, clean design styles (Apple-like / minimal)

Job DescriptionAs a Customer Success Manager at Eptura, you will be responsible for managing a book of business, driving user adoption, and ensuring customer retention. Your primary goals will be to maximize customer growth and minimize churn by building strong relationships, identifying upsell opportunities, and guiding customers through their journey with our products.

Responsibilities

CSM Responsibilities:
  • Manage a portfolio of accounts by thoroughly understanding growth drivers, identifying opportunities for growth, and managing risks.
  • Meet and exceed net retention and gross churn targets for assigned accounts.
  • Help customers translate their business use cases into company solutions.
  • Manage customer stakeholders effectively and build long lasting relationships to leverage during difficult times.
  • Act as the primary post-sale customer contact to guarantee successful onboarding, user adoption, and retention, i.e own the overall success of the account.

  • Contribute as necessary to the success of CS operations projects that are address gaps within the customer journey.
  • Provide feedback and support to the enablement team in their new initiatives, as necessary
  • Maintain updated records and forecasting accuracy in all systems (Salesforce and CS management tool).

About You

You are a customer-obsessed professional who defines success by your customers’ ability to realize value from the products they use. You’re passionate about delivering exceptional experiences and building long-term, trusted relationships.
  • You bring a strong understanding of Customer Success as both a discipline and a strategic function, with proven experience managing a book of business.
  • You’re data-savvy and comfortable identifying trends and patterns to inform customer strategies and drive outcomes.
  • You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace change, and are eager to adopt new processes and tools that improve the customer journey.
  • You’re a continuous learner who enjoys understanding technology from the user’s perspective and applying that knowledge to help customers succeed.

  • You understand key Customer Success metrics like Gross Retention, Net Retention, CSAT, and health scores—and know how to influence them.
  • You’re results-driven, with a background in Customer Success, Account Management, or other customer-facing roles focused on retention, adoption, and growth.

Grafana Labs is a remote-first, open-source powerhouse. Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries. We’re committed to providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience that helps our users build trust within their company and with their customers.

But don’t let that corporate description fool you—the people behind our buttoned-up product are laid-back (but hardworking), genuine, and kickass, and you could be one of them!

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to own the strategy, systems, analytics, and operational frameworks that power demand generation and pipeline growth.

In this role, you’ll serve as the operational backbone of the marketing organization, ensuring campaigns are executed at scale, marketing performance is measured accurately, and teams have the systems and data they need to drive results. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance to align marketing execution with pipeline and revenue goals.

Bringing both a strategic lens and strong implementation mindset, you’ll ensure marketing initiatives are supported by best-in-class processes, automation, and data integrity in a fast-growing SaaS environment.

Location: This is a remote position. You must live and work permanently in the U.S. to be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Own and optimize the marketing technology ecosystem, ensuring platforms are integrated, scalable, and aligned with go-to-market processes
  • Administer and enhance marketing automation platforms while maintaining strong data governance and system performance
  • Manage integrations between marketing platforms and Salesforce to ensure reliable data flow and reporting accuracy
  • Build and maintain marketing dashboards and reporting frameworks that track pipeline creation, campaign performance, CAC, and ROI
  • Design and evolve multi-touch attribution models that accurately measure marketing’s contribution to revenue
  • Provide insights that help marketing leadership optimize channel mix, campaign performance, and budget allocation
  • Define and operationalize scalable processes for campaign execution, segmentation, and automation workflows
  • Own lead lifecycle operations from capture through qualification, opportunity creation, and closed-won
  • Partner with Sales to establish and maintain lead routing, follow-up SLAs, and feedback loops
  • Support demand generation and ABM programs through segmentation, account scoring, and campaign analytics
  • Lead cross-functional projects that improve marketing execution, systems performance, and pipeline generation
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies, automation, and AI-driven capabilities that enhance marketing performance

The Impact You'll Have

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems—and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

  • Building scalable systems that power demand generation and pipeline growth
  • Increasing visibility into marketing performance and return on investment
  • Improving alignment between Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations teams
  • Enabling more efficient campaign execution through automation and optimized workflows

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales, RevOps, and Finance teams
  • A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.
  • A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $123,000-$143,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. POSITION SUMMARY:

Reporting to the Director of Architecture, we are seeking an experienced, highly motivated Cloud Architect to join our growing, dynamic healthcare organization. The Cloud Architect will be a strategic thought leader who’s responsible for designing, building, and maintaining cloud-based solutions at the BMC system-wide level that are performant, secure, compliant, and scalable. This role will focus on improving healthcare delivery by leveraging cutting-edge public and hybrid-cloud technologies, partnering with BMCHS Information Security to ensure data security / privacy, and optimizing platform performance, while adhering to healthcare regulations such as HIPAA and HITRUST.

Position: AWS Cloud Architect

Department: Information Technology

Schedule: Full Time

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

All duties listed below have a Health System-wide impact and are done in close partnership with key IT leaders, with the Cloud Architect serving as the technical expert guiding and leading implementation efforts

  • Cloud Architecture Design: Design and implement cloud infrastructure tailored for mission-critical healthcare applications, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance.

  • Compliance and Security: Develop and maintain systems in accordance with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) to ensure data security, privacy, and compliance.

  • Collaboration with Teams: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Cloud Operations, network engineering, infrastructure engineering, IT, and other business units to understand requirements and deliver effective cloud solutions.

  • Cloud Service Management: Oversee and optimize the use of AWS cloud services to ensure cost efficiency and resource management.

  • Data Management: Architect cloud solutions for large-scale healthcare data management, including Electronic Health Records (EHR), Patient Health Information (PHI), and medical data analytics.

  • Disaster Recovery & Backup: Work closely with the Storage and Virtualization Team to design and implement robust disaster recovery and data backup plans that ensure business continuity and meet healthcare industry standards.

  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, identifying and resolving issues proactively to maintain operational efficiency.

  • Cost Reporting: Monitor cloud service spend and work cross-functionally to identify and implement strategies for optimizing and scaling appropriately.

  • Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest trends and best practices in cloud computing and broader healthcare technology and apply innovative solutions to improve healthcare delivery.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).

JOB REQUIREMENTS

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and at least 7 years of progressive, demonstrated experience in AWS (and/or) multi-cloud cloud architecture; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience with cloud-based data storage, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.

  • Experience with DevOps tools and automation (e.g., CloudFormation, AWS CDK, AWS Landing Zone Accelerator, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins).

  • Experience assessing, testing, implementing modern platform visibility solutions (DataDog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Prometheus / Grafana).

  • Experience with healthcare IT systems such as EMR/HER (Epic).

  • Experience with cloud-based data warehouses, data lakes, and data pipelines.

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 3 years of experience focused on healthcare-related solutions in and AWS cloud environment is preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • Up to date certification in at least one relevant cloud platform (AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, etc.).

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS PREFERRED:

  • Certification in multiple cloud platforms

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing cloud infrastructures (AWS) using IaC (infrastructure as code).

  • Demonstrated history of migrating enterprise-scale data center workloads into AWS utilizing native and 3rd party tooling.

  • Strong understanding and demonstrated history of architecting cloud-based systems utilizing the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

  • Strong understanding of industry regulations such as HIPAA & HITRUST, and other relevant compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, identity management, and encryption protocols.

  • Familiarity with healthcare-specific software platforms and technologies (e.g., EHR systems like Epic, healthcare analytics tools).

  • Knowledge of cloud-native machine learning and AI applications in a healthcare setting.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Check out Magic's Business Profile

About This Role
💰 UNCAPPED COMMISSIONS — the more you close, the more you earn. No ceiling.
Top performers hit 80–150% of monthly target consistently. At 100% quota: $3,500–$4,500/mo. At 150%: $5,000+/mo. All USD, paid monthly.

  • 🇧🇬 Sofia, Bulgaria — equivalent to £70,000+ London lifestyle. 60%+ monthly savings. 10% flat income tax.
  • 🇵🇱 Warsaw, Poland — USD pay dramatically stronger than local zloty salaries.

  • 🇷🇴 Bucharest, Romania — fastest internet in Europe. Very low cost of living.
  • 🇹🇭 Chiang Mai, Thailand — comfortable lifestyle at $1,200–1,600/mo. 65%+ savings.
We welcome B2B, B2C, and outbound sales backgrounds. UK and European sales professionals with Western market experience are exactly who U.S. buyers respond to.

High-volume inbound sales with 50+ warm leads per month. No cold calling. No lead hunting.
Magic is a Silicon Valley-backed platform (Y Combinator + Sequoia) that connects U.S. SMBs with remote workers and virtual assistants. Our Inside Sales Executives handle the full inbound sales cycle — from the first discovery call to the signed contract. We provide the leads; you close them with professionalism and consistency.

  • 💰 UNCAPPED COMMISSIONS — top performers earn $5,000+/month consistently

  • OTE $2,500–$4,500/mo USD — no ceiling above it
  • 4 hours of US Eastern/Central time overlap required — rest of day is yours
  • YC + Sequoia backing on your CV regardless of where you work

  • Collaborate remotely with Sales, Ops, and Support for smooth client onboarding
  • Apply coaching fast and contribute deal insights to the broader team

  • B2B sales — SaaS, subscription, outsourcing, professional services, tech

What Temperature Management Contributes to Cardinal Health

The Temperature Management team ensures the safe handling of pharmaceutical and medical products by overseeing all temperature excursion events. This includes:

  • Serving as the point of contact with pharmaceutical and medical manufacturers to obtain product stability information following a temperature excursion.

  • Assessing stability data to determine product impact and ensure patient safety.

  • Maintaining required continuing education to support Health Care Professional certification, which is necessary for engaging with manufacturers that release stability information only to certified professionals.

This position serves as the primary contact with manufacturers, supports facilities with excursion documentation, and maintains key stability and excursion data. The role also contributes to the Quality Management System by administering temperature monitoring platforms, assisting with temperature studies across multiple facilities, and supporting related projects. About Us

Defuse Labs develops NEAR Intents to enable seamless cross-chain interactions in an automated world — connecting AI, services, and financial applications. At Defuse Labs we design intent-driven liquidity layers, where smart contracts breathe, AI transacts and chains sync in real-time With expertise in AI, cryptography, and decentralized finance, our team is redefining how intelligent agents interact across blockchain networks.

We invite you to be a part of our team of smart, professional, result-oriented and fun individuals. Join us to help ensure that our background processes run smoothly while we are striving to become the best in the industry.

About the Position

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to contribute to the improvement and maintenance of the innovative DApps in the NEAR ecosystem. Someone who wants to work in a fast-paced start-up and is motivated at the prospect of building something new from the ground up, gets engaged at an early stage of projects.

This position is focused on building a blazing-fast frontend and an SDK for a cross-chain DEX utilizing multi-party computation, chain signatures, secure enclaves and intent-based architecture. Our goal is to bridge the gaps between EVM and non-EVM chains so a deep understanding of web3 technologies is required.

You will work closely with the Protocol team, designers, QA and external partners to provide the best possible user and developer experience. You will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation, taking an active role on both sides and defining how the application looks as well as how it works.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Ensuring that precise financial instruments are easy to use and to understand.
  • Optimizing every millisecond of user interactions.
  • Implementing deep tracing and observability of user flows.
  • Creating the best SDK for other DApps to use.
  • Designing, testing and implementing the most resilient state machines for managing RFQs.

Here are some of the technologies we work with:

  • Typescript.
  • React.
  • Next.js.
  • Xstate.
  • Wagmi.
  • DatoCMS.
  • React Native.

Must have:

  • 10+ years of experience as a software engineer, with a proven track record of shipping products.
  • Strong sense for design and UI/UX.
  • Ability to code with multiple target form factors (mobile, tablet, desktop) in mind.
  • Experience in building functional and effective platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring clean, organized, and maintainable code.
  • The ability to effectively collaborate with coworkers across multiple time zones.
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies.

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A little more about your role…

There is a political consensus that infrastructure investment is vital and serves an enduring purpose. At all levels of UK government, projects are being taken forward that support sustainable economic growth, decarbonise the movement of goods and people, and modernise the services received by end users. At WSP, we draw on experience from working on over 36,000 transport and infrastructure projects in over 40 countries across 6 continents. As one of the global leaders in transport and infrastructure we are commitment to sustainable transport and connecting communities.

As one of the largest environmental consultancies in the UK, you’ll get the opportunity to contribute to nationally significant transport projects and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. You’ll be encouraged to explore new ideas in a culture that values curiosity and diverse perspectives.

With the continued changes and demand on the UK transport sector comes increased scrutiny and a more complex consenting environment. As a Senior Consultant or Principal Consultant in our Resilient Infrastructure team, you’ll play a role in navigating this landscape—supporting transport expansion through strategic planning, environmental advice, and technical studies.

You’ll contribute to some of the UK’s most significant and transformative transport infrastructure projects, delivering services such as planning applications, EIA, GRIP Stages, and support for DCO examinations and planning inquiries to name a few.

This is a post which is of strategic significance for our business and represents a challenging and exciting opportunity to identify, win and deliver multi-disciplinary inputs for transport infrastructure projects. We need people with creative spirit, a dedicated approach and a solid grounding in environmental design, assessment and management at any stage of the development project lifecycle.

Join a great organisation

As a Senior Consultant or Principal Consultant, you will collaborate with a diverse team of technical specialists and design professionals to lead and coordinate environmental contributions across project designs and assessments. You will be instrumental in improving the environmental performance for a range of projects.

The role would suit an enthusiastic individual looking to influence, lead and deliver environmental elements of transportation infrastructure projects. You will have responsibility for directing and leading projects including tasks relating to recruitment, bidding, project team management, project delivery, and financial management.

  • Managing the delivery of a diverse range of environmental inputs into transport projects including planning applications, EIA, and support for DCO examinations and/or planning inquiries.
  • An awareness of and experience in the delivery of environmental inputs into projects including EIA screening requests and scoping reports, environmental constraints studies, environmental management plans and Environmental Statements.
  • Building relationships with clients and identifying opportunities to provide support in areas such as resourcing, programming, strategy development and project delivery.
  • Undertaking activities to secure new work, including preparing proposals, contributing to strategic-bid preparation, and participating in business development opportunities.
  • Supporting the development of innovative techniques to shape the way we do our business whether through Digital EIA, Technical Excellence, Future Ready EIA etc.
  • Inspiring and upskilling junior colleagues to support their career development.
  • Promoting an inclusive workplace, demonstrating an understanding of Health and Safety whilst living the values of our health, safety, and wellbeing culture.
  • Undertaking actions that contribute towards the success of the WSP business strategy, whilst being self-motivated towards goals relevant to the role, team, and your projects.

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

  • A relevant environmental degree level qualification in EIA, or similar.
  • Achieved or demonstrably working towards Practitioner or Chartered Environmental Status and Full membership of IEMA, or similar qualification with a relevant professional body.
  • Familiarity with relevant consenting processes associated with transport infrastructure and transport-related projects, including Habitats Regulations Assessment (HRA), Environmental Permit applications etc. Understanding of how these processes integrate with the planning system and EIA for rail and road schemes, transport improvement works, rail sidings, or station and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Demonstrates the ability to apply programme knowledge to effectively coordinate tasks across technical teams, external clients, stakeholders, and partner organisations, while consistently delivering projects or tasks on time and within budget, in full compliance with business management procedures.
  • Ability to lead and contribute to meetings with the wider technical team and external clients and stakeholders.
  • Advantageous to understand HS2, Transport for London (TfL), Pathway, WebTAG experience, Network Rail and/or London Underground requirements.
  • Experience in coordinating a suite of environmental surveys required to support an EIA for transport schemes, with knowledge of the associated Health and Safety requirements.
  • Experience in bid preparation and responding to client change requests with appropriate fee adjustments for transport infrastructure projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong report writing and review capabilities, attention to detail, and a focus on quality assurance.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

raw.title: Engineering Manager - Member Experience Client Foundations
raw.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
raw.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Team

The Member Experience Client Foundations team (MXCF) is responsible for building the server-driven UI (SDUI) architecture and tooling used to power the member user experience across Netflix’s iOS, Android, TV and Web client streaming applications.

The team is responsible for working closely with our server foundational partners on this SDUI architecture to ensure that we’re building holistic solutions which balance client architectural considerations across all four client platforms, alongside our server partner’s distributed system concerns.

Allowing us to deliver a flexible, scalable SDUI platform on which both our client & server product teams can deliver the innovative member experiences which Netflix sets the industry standard for.

MXCF is a foundational team. We don’t build product experiences directly. We build architecture and tooling which empowers product engineers (our customers), to build great product experiences, efficiently and reliably.

We’re currently working to evolve our SDUI architecture’s capabilities to support:

  • A flexible spectrum of server-driven rendering : From coarse-grained control through to fine grained UI control; or none at all, based on product needs.

  • Pushing UI updates to the client both for exceedingly high-scale needs (simultaneous concurrent updates for live events), as well user experience updates at lower scale.

  • Dynamically modify the UI in response to the user’s session interaction and needs.

  • Efficiently support the increasingly wide variety of content types and business verticals (shows, movies, games, ads, live, acquisition) which Netflix supports.

The team has a well established mix of experienced and early career engineers, working across the iOS, Android and TV client platforms. All of them, regardless of years of experience, are mature engineers, passionate about living the Netflix culture, and pursuing the next big challenge.

The Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager for MXCF.

The role requires managing complex partnerships with both client and server teams. Working with server partners as “one-team” delivering a holistic end-to-end SDUI platform. While being able to represent, and advocate strongly for client product and foundational UI engineering concerns. Helping forge SDUI vision, architecture and execution alignment across both.

Critical to the team’s success is the ability to then guide, coach and support the engineers navigating this client-server balance. Empowering them to excel in collaborations across these broadly cross-functional customer and partner teams.

Being a foundational team, the role involves shaping a customer-empathetic team culture which grounds technical solutions in the value it unlocks for product experiences and product engineering. Balancing product engineering velocity needs, with steady state platform leverage.

It provides the unique opportunity to pivot between architectural, people and project execution leadership, influencing well beyond the team’s boundaries, to deliver an SDUI platform which will power Netflix’s ambitious member experience goals.

You

As a leader, you prefer to navigate ambiguity, own your judgment calls and work through complex partnership alignment, based on your close understanding of the team, the work they do, and its relationship to the business. Rather than having some distant leadership level make that call for you, or provide you with top-down prescriptive rules to do so.

As a coach, you enter each week excited about exploring ways to help your team deliver world class foundational solutions.

Whether through the people:Building diverse, inclusive teams. Challenging them with impactful opportunities. Creating space for perspectives which question the status quo. Giving them the autonomy to apply their engineering maturity, while ensuring their work aligns with business needs through clear communication and precise context. Being a mentor for career growth; sharing clear expectations and candid feedback, while being a partner in navigating challenges.

Or, through the technology:Building the foundational mindset within which the team can operate. Starting with technology choices being a means to an end; the ultimate goal being to empower product engineers and unlock business value. Understanding that there are no technology absolutes, and it’s all about the trade-offs we choose to prioritize. Finding the right mix of tech-debt adoption and paved road investment to balance velocity with leverage. Building innovative technology solutions is just the start. Driving adoption, planning for migration, and making sure the solution delivers value for customer teams is your definition of “done”.

What Sets You Apart

  • 3+ years of experience leading a foundational client team, building solutions for other engineers.

  • Experience with client UI architecture & workflows on at least one platform (Mobile, Web, TV).

  • Have wins, and losses, from leading complex cross-functional architecture initiatives.

  • Able to efficiently drive alignment with customer & partner teams on one-off velocity vs. paved road leverage trade-offs.

  • Have the curiosity and courage to explore uncharted waters.

  • Colleagues appreciate the additive perspectives & balanced views you bring to collaborations, while not shying away from taking strong positions when needed.

  • Have a talent in distilling complex, ambiguous positions or scenarios down to succinct principles.

  • Are committed to the value different perspectives bring to a team and invest in an inclusive culture that enables colleagues of all backgrounds to thrive.

  • Understand all of us have strengths & weaknesses; giving you the courage to invest in feedback. Soliciting it, to help yourself grow, and giving it help your colleagues grow.

If this resonates, we’d love to talk!

What’s Different About Us

  • Scale, Impact : You’ll be a key contributor in defining and delivering the server-driven platform which powers the member experience for hundreds of millions of Netflix users across the globe. Setting the foundation for our next phase of product evolution and improving innovation velocity for over 200 client engineers, across more than 10 product and foundational teams, on our Mobile, TV and Web client platforms.

  • Architectural Leadership : This isn’t just about people or project management. We rely on managers to bring architectural vision to the table. Guiding engineers in the foundational architecture investments we make, and helping set our technical north star direction.

  • People over Process : That said, it all starts with the people. Hiring “unusually responsible”, mature, stunning colleagues is a responsibility managers have to the team. It’s the non-negotiable on which we ground the rest of our culture. Allowing us to provide engineers with the business context they need and letting them make great autonomous decisions in their day-to-day work.

  • Distributed teams : We have teammates across the US. Some of us work from the office, some, from home. The team is committed to ensuring remote work is a collaborative and productive experience for everyone.

  • Our Culture: Lastly, but most importantly, we live by our values.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $436,000.00 - $710,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

Atout : BPMN: pour Cartographie de processus

Savoir faire/être

  • Besoin d'une personne hyper autonome. Environnement complexe peu mature.
  • Avoir un côté et ou être versatile c.a.d : Hands on et haut niveau en architecture
  • Il recherche un architecte aguerri ayant un sens politique (relationnel) élevé afin de naviguer dans les différentes unités d’affaires.
  • Une personne HANDS ON qui est très fort en données, un gros travail en donnée à faire au niveau de l'architecture et de leur solution

Responsabilités principales :

  • Effectuer une architecture détaillée, cartographie
  • Participer à faire l’intégrations des solutions (progiciels) existantes et en processus d’intégrations (avoir un côté Hands On)
  • S'approprier l'architecture en place, travailler sur des projets inter fonctionnels voir même participer à la réalisation et l’exécution

  • Collaborer avec des fournisseurs de données et des équipes internes pour l'amélioration de la performance opérationnelle et la compétitivité

SOMMAIRE
Sous la responsabilité du Directeur Adjoint, systèmes corporatifs, le titulaire du poste est responsable de l’angle technologique et technique des solutions d’affaires qui composent l’écosystème de l’entreprise. Il (elle) doit proposer des solutions visant l’amélioration des processus et participer au développement de nouveaux systèmes et produits. De plus, il(elle) doit veiller à l’optimisation des applications existantes et s’assurer qu’elles bénéficient d’un programme d’amélioration continue efficace et adéquat pour les domaines d’affaires de l’entreprise.

RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITÉS
• Comprendre le contexte d’affaires et l’impact des projets sur l’écosystème technologique de l’organisation;
• De concert avec les architectes TI, identifie les opportunités reliées à l’amélioration des processus et assure une veille relative aux tendances technologiques pouvant contribuer à cette amélioration;
• Analyser et définir des solutions pour optimiser les processus existants, conduit des analyses comparatives pour identifier les meilleures pratiques;
• Documenter, modéliser et schématiser les processus ciblés;
• Contribuer à la planification stratégique des systèmes d’information;
• Documenter les besoins technologiques et les spécifications fonctionnelles techniques, analyser et cerner les contraintes et les impacts et émettre des recommandations;
• Produire les études d’opportunités, de faisabilités, les analyses coûts/bénéfices et les propositions de projet;
• De concert avec le gestionnaire de projet, documenter la portée des projets, leurs objectifs, leur valeur ajoutée de même que les bénéfices attendus et les estimées de réalisation;
• De concert avec le gestionnaire de projet et les propriétaires des processus, élaborer les stratégies et approches de formation, de communication et de déploiement des solutions d’affaires;
• Participer avec l’équipe d’intégration et l’équipe support à l’élaboration de la solution logicielle et technologique correspondant aux besoins d’affaires;
• Valider la solution, accompagner le client dans la phase d’acceptation et de déploiement;
• Élaborer les stratégies et mettre en œuvre des plans de tests techniques et contribuer au plan de recouvrement;
• Soutenir les membres des équipes de projets de telle sorte que les besoins soient bien compris et que les solutions livrées correspondent aux attentes;
• Planifier, coordonner et réaliser au besoin la formation des utilisateurs.
• Coordonner avec les équipes de la DTI, le fournisseur, s’il y a lieu, et le gestionnaire, la mise en place des demandes de changement et des implantations des nouvelles versions des applications.
• Fournir une assistance lors d’incident ou de problèmes.
• Valider et assurer l’application de la sécurité

• Participer à l’évaluation des fournisseurs externes et participe à la définition des niveaux de services.
• Réaliser les tâches administratives nécessaires à la bonne gestion et toute autre tâche connexe à la fonction.

Why AIS?

When you join AIS, you’re joining a mission-driven team that’s passionate about making a difference. You’ll work on projects that matter, alongside industry-leading experts, in an environment that fosters innovation, driving client success, and empowering our team to make a lasting impact. As an employee-owned company, we value collaboration, inclusivity, continuous growth, and shared success.

  • Employee Ownership: Your contributions directly impact the company’s success, and you share in its achievements.

  • Continuous Learning: Access to resources, training, and mentorship to support your professional growth.

  • Inclusive Culture: A workplace where diversity is celebrated, and everyone’s voice is valued.

  • Mission-Driven Work: Engage in projects that make a meaningful difference for our clients and communities.

What are we looking for?

At AIS, we're looking for more than just skills - we're looking for driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference, eager to grow, and aligned with our core principles.

What you will be doing?

This position is contingent upon contract award. We are currently pursuing a proposal and are seeking qualified candidates to include in our submission and identify candidates for future hiring needs on the program once awarded.

At AIS, we are dedicated to providing our employees with diverse opportunities to grow their careers while supporting a variety of impactful projects. For this position, we are seeking a talented individual to join AIS as a Senior Project Manager.

  • Core Knowledge & Skills: Expert in advanced project management methodologies, strategic planning, and complex contract management. Deep understanding of industry best practices and business unit operations.

  • Work & Complexity: Oversees large, complex projects or programs, manages cross-functional teams, and ensures alignment with organizational goals. Resolves high-impact risks and issues.

  • Quality & Independence: Sets quality benchmarks, drives strategic initiatives, and operates with broad autonomy and accountability.

  • Teamwork & Communication: Leads and mentors project teams, fosters collaboration across departments, and communicates effectively with senior leadership and clients.

  • Consulting & Engagement: Advises executives and stakeholders on project strategy, drives innovation, and champions continuous improvement across the organization.

As your initial project assignment, you will support the unique needs of our client as a Transition In/Out Coordinator.

Position Overview

The Transition-In/Out Coordinator is responsible for managing the seamless onboarding and offboarding of personnel, equipment, and services across the program lifecycle. This role requires expertise in systems engineering and people management, ensuring operational continuity and compliance during transitions. The ideal candidate will serve as the primary interface with the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team and maintain accurate documentation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and manage onboarding requirements for all staff.

  • Develop and maintain Playbooks for personnel, equipment, services, and O&M transition activities.

  • Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are created, updated, and implemented for Contracting Officers (COs).

  • Act as the primary interface with the O&M team to coordinate transition activities.

  • Serve as liaison between business and technical aspects of projects.

  • Plan project stages and assess business implications for each stage.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: BA/BS degree in a related field.

  • Experience: 5+ years of project management experience, preferably in DoD or similar environments.

  • Certifications: Agile Scrum certification required; PMP preferred.

  • Clearance: Active Top Secret Clearance is mandatory.

  • Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and transition planning.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience developing transition playbooks and SOPs.

  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition and compliance requirements.

  • Ability to manage complex onboarding and offboarding processes in a remote environment.

At AIS, we are committed to offering competitive and fair compensation that reflects the skills, experience, and contributions of each team member.The targeted base salary range for this role is $0-$0 per year. Please note that this range is provided as a guideline and the final offer will be based on several factors, including but not limited to, skillset and competencies, level of experience, education, certifications, and location.We value transparency in our hiring process and are happy to discuss how your unique qualifications align with our compensation structure during the interview process.

GenLogs is a hardware, software, and data company building the next generation of Truck Intelligence™. Our mission is to build unbreakable supply chains in order to make our world safer and stronger. Through a nationwide network of sensors, we help our customers source carriers, eliminate fraud and theft, and provide real-time visibility on every truck in America. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.

ABOUT THE GO-TO-MARKET TEAM

  • The Go-to-Market (GTM) team at GenLogs is responsible for bringing our Truck Intelligence™ platform to the organization that depend on trustworthy, real-time freight visibility. We work directly with brokers, carriers, shippers, insurance companies, and ports to define problems, scope operational deployments, and scale high-impact programs.
  • The Customer Support function is one of many distinct arms of the larger GTM umbrella, which also includes: Business Development, Sales, Pre-Sales, Customer Support, Partnerships, Channel, and Marketing
  • As a Technical CSR, you will serve as a central point of contact for users, resolving issues, troubleshooting bugs, and equipping users with GenLogs capabilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

The primary focus of the Technical Customer Support Representative role is to provide world-class technical support to GenLogs’ day-to-day users. As a Technical CSR, you will have a direct impact on the customer experience and are vital to custom adoption of our data/software. You will serve as the initial point of contact for all technical questions, primarily via email and secondarily via Google Meet as necessary.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop a deep understanding and expertise of our platform, data, APIs, and customer base
  • Create, Read, Update, and Delete: Manage ongoing CRUD within backend customer/user database to ensure proper permissions and access
  • Respond to technical user questions and issues with urgency, clarity, and empathy via email/chat. For particularly complex issues, meet with customer technical teams via Google Meet
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues by guiding them through workflows and identifying user errors vs. product bugs
  • Document and take detailed notes in our support ticketing system.
  • Following up daily on tickets to ensure the customer is taken care of as quickly as possible.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Integrations teams to translate user feedback into scalable solutions
  • Assist Customer Success Managers in day to day technical support of users. This may include user onboarding, training, and ongoing office hours to user success

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years experience in IT or technical user support
  • Excellent written communication and documentation skills
  • High ownership and follow-through in driving issues to resolution
  • Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, and relational databases
  • SQL experience required
  • B2B SaaS experience preferred but not required
  • Transportation or Insurance experience preferred but not required

BENEFITS

Healthcare

  • Employer-covered comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for employee and dependents
  • Employer contribution towards premiums of optional higher-end plans

Time Off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Sick leave
  • Company holidays (GenLogs observes all federal US Government holidays)
  • Flexible leave for caregiving and medical needs

Family Support

  • Paid parental leave

Professional Development

  • Budget availability for approved professional development courses, certifications, and training

Travel Support

  • 100% travel reimbursement for all approved company travel and spending

Title:Customer Support Specialist

Reports to:Service Operations Manager

Location: Remote, US

Shift details: Flexible to work nights and weekends. Training schedule for the first 6 weeks will vary.

About the Role:We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Customer Service Specialist to join our growing Service Operations team. This entry-level role focuses on providing outstanding customer support by assisting with inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a seamless customer experience. You’ll collaborate with various teams and learn to effectively manage day-to-day customer interactions while gaining valuable skills in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Support & Issue Resolution:

  • Respond to customer inquiries via email and phone, providing prompt and accurate assistance.
  • Address and resolve common customer issues, escalating complex cases to the appropriate team when necessary.
  • Conduct follow-ups to ensure all customer concerns are addressed and resolved.
  • Document customer interactions and resolutions in CharterUP’s proprietary software system.

Live Trip Monitoring:

  • Assist customers, drivers, or operations teams with urgent support requests.
  • Manage unexpected events (e.g., traffic, vehicle breakdowns, weather issues) by coordinating alternative solutions.

Customer Relationship Management:

Operations Coordination:

Documentation & Process Adherence:

Escalation Management:

Continuous Improvement & Learning:

Experience and Skills:

  • 0-2 years of customer service or logistics coordination experience; experience in transportation, hospitality, or similar industries is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in fast-paced or high-pressure situations.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask effectively.
  • A customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service.
  • Willingness to adapt to changing priorities and learn new systems or processes.

Recruiting Process:

raw.excerpt: About ScholarshipOwlScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.
raw.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection.

You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.

  • Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets.

  • Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why.

  • Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.

  • Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.

  • Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of Product Management experience, specifically in a **Growth-**focused role.

  • Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).

  • Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.

  • SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.

  • Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.

  • Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.

  • Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.

  • Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.

  • Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing, SEO, and paid acquisition channels.

  • Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).

  • Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities.

  • Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine.

  • Unlimited PTO – We value results over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

  • Home Office Budget – $200/month to invest in your ideal remote workspace.

  • Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth.

  • Annual Company Off-sites – Connect with your teammates in person at various locations around the globe.

Ready to move the needle? Apply now and show us how you’d build the future of student growth.

Highlights

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription.
